verdict.rationale: Google Cloud documents a single platform-wide `gcloud` CLI reference that manages interactions with the Google Cloud APIs. It also has a REST reference for a non-flagship service (Cloud Billing), a Cloud Run MCP reference, and a general Cloud APIs page offering REST and client-library access. That suggests reference coverage beyond flagship services, but the pack shows only a handful of services, so breadth and consistency across 'every service' are inferred rather than shown. missing for 10: evidence of per-service API/CLI reference coverage across the full catalog, evidence of a consistent reference format across services, independent or hands-on corroboration of reference-doc quality and completeness.
